shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum posted major weekly gains with $2.8 billion in U.S. spot ETF inflows, despite BTC facing resistance around $80,000.
Markets are awaiting interest rate and monetary policy cues from the upcoming Jackson Hole speech.
July headline PCE inflation hit 3.7%, indicating persistent inflation that may trigger further Federal Reserve tightening.
The SEC proposed new crypto custody rules for investment advisers, while Charles Schwab expanded its crypto platform to include SOL, AVAX, and LINK.
The Trump administration launched Operation Economic Outcast against Iran, escalating geopolitical financial pressure.
